title.en: CS capstone: a verified dependency planner
title.zh: CS 综合项目：可验证依赖规划器

lead.en: Build and defend a planner with precedence and critical-path certificates, cycle witnesses, exact duration laws, Monte Carlo evidence and explicit resource limits.
lead.zh: 构建并答辩带优先关键路径证书、环见证、精确工期律、MC 证据与资源限制的规划器。

prerequisites.en: Modules 04, 06, 07, 08, 21 and 24; Python 3.11+. All three reference scripts use the standard library.
prerequisites.zh: 需模块 04、06、07、08、21、24 和 Python 3.11+。三参考脚本均标准库。

en: Specify and validate an eight-task dependency model.
Prove order, termination and earliest-finish recurrence.
Return independently checkable cycle and critical-path witnesses.
Separate graph operation counts, canonicalisation and worker constraints.
Enumerate and simulate independent/dependent completion laws.
Defend every claim with artefacts and a weighted assessment.
zh: 明确验证八任务依赖模型。
证明顺序、终止及最早时间递推。
返回可独立核查环与关键路径。
区分图计数、规范化及工作者约束。
枚举模拟独立相关完成律。
以材料和评分答辩各声明。

plotAlt.en: Exact completion-time masses at three and five: independent .25/.75 and shared-delay .5/.5.
plotAlt.zh: 三、五处精确质量：独立 .25/.75，共享延迟 .5/.5。

text.en: Write the input/output and invalid-case contract.
text.zh: 写输入输出及无效约定。

text.en: Construct the eight-task graph and cycle fixture.
text.zh: 构造八任务图及环样例。

text.en: Predict empty, edge and timing results.
text.zh: 预测空输入、边和时间结果。

text.en: Derive the indegree invariant and cycle obligation.
text.zh: 推入度不变量及环义务。

text.en: Write order, termination, finish and path proofs.
text.zh: 写顺序、终止、时间及路径证明。

text.en: Count operations and identify the arithmetic model.
text.zh: 计数操作并明确算术模型。

text.en: Implement and check the planner and cycle certificates.
text.zh: 实现检查规划器及环证书。

text.en: Challenge invalid inputs, checksums and worker scope.
text.zh: 挑战无效输入、校验和及工作者范围。

text.en: Review actual fault evidence and proof/code correspondence.
text.zh: 核查实际故障及证明代码对应。

text.en: Enumerate and simulate both joint duration models.
text.zh: 枚举模拟两联合工期模型。

text.en: Write the report and complete the mathematical defence.
text.zh: 写报告并完成数学答辩。

text.en: Assess the seven artefacts and mandatory pass conditions.
text.zh: 评七材料及必需通过条件。
